run_image_classification_training: run image classification training by passing a training config JSON file path via the --training_config CLI argument
train_image_model: train an image classification model using HuggingFace Transformers Trainer with a provided config dict or ImageClassificationParams object
parse_training_args: parse command line arguments to extract the path to a training_config JSON file for image classification
push_model_to_hub: push a trained image classification model and image processor to a private HuggingFace Hub repository after training completes
create_model_card: generate a model card README for the trained image classification model using the config and trainer metrics
